text: quick question is json the correct format to store in, i know that @GUIDING_LIGHT.md has things to say about this
resolution: Answered the format question: JSON is correct for the package's authoring-side files (manifest.json, editmesh.json, stroke-program paints) — V29 explicitly keeps JSON as the SOURCE format (.vmf role) and rules binary for the COMPILED artifact; mesh/base.blob already follows the 'meshes are raw aligned f32' ruling. Flagged the real violations: the hmsc-int snapshots (33MB of JSON with mesh floats and base64 textures parsed every editor boot) and legacy base64-RGBA paint variants. No code changed.
